title.zh-Hant: 從分鏡到影片：Snowy HyperFrames 工作流 v2
title.en: From Storyboard to Video: Snowy HyperFrames Workflow v2

title.zh-Hant: 一份分鏡，一個時間真相

subtitle.zh-Hant: 這支影片的每一個時間點，都來自 storyboard 與實際量測的旁白長度。
subtitle.en: Every timestamp comes from the storyboard and measured narration—not guesswork.

narration.zh-Hant: 這支影片本身就是一個示範。它的每一個時間點，都不是人手估的，而是來自一份 storyboard，加上實際量測出來的旁白長度。
narration.en: This film is also its own demonstration. Every timestamp comes from one storyboard and the measured duration of the real narration, never from a hand estimate.

title.zh-Hant: 過去：六個檔案手動同步
title.en: Before: six files synchronized by hand

subtitle.zh-Hant: index.html、字幕、manifest、project.json 各有一份時間軸；MP3 比頁面長，旁白就被切掉。
subtitle.en: Six timing copies could drift; when an MP3 ran long, the narration was cut short.

narration.zh-Hant: 過去每次重新生成旁白，index.html、字幕、manifest 和 project.json 都要分別手動修改。只要某一段 MP3 比頁面長，旁白就會在成片裡被硬生生切斷。
narration.en: Before, every regenerated voice meant editing index dot HTML, captions, manifests, and project metadata separately. If one MP3 ran longer than its slide, the final video cut the narration short.

title.zh-Hant: 現在：一條可重跑的管線

subtitle.zh-Hant: prepare-tts → tts → measure → sync：storyboard 產生朗讀稿，量測 MP3，回寫所有時間軸。
subtitle.en: prepare-tts → tts → measure → sync turns one storyboard into every timing surface.

narration.zh-Hant: 現在流程只有一條。storyboard 產生朗讀稿，Edge-TTS 生成 MP3，ffprobe 量出實際長度，然後 sync 把時間軸一次寫回頁面、字幕與 metadata。
narration.en: Now there is one pipeline. The storyboard produces the script, Edge TTS creates each MP3, ffprobe measures its real length, and sync updates the page, captions, and metadata together.

subtitle.zh-Hant: hf audit 檢查結構、schema 與音訊截斷風險；hyperframes check 檢查 runtime、版面與對比度。
subtitle.en: hf audit verifies the contract; HyperFrames check verifies the browser result.

narration.zh-Hant: render 之前要先過兩道門。hf audit 檢查專案結構、schema，以及音訊截斷風險；hyperframes check 則檢查 runtime、版面與文字對比度。
narration.en: Render waits behind two gates. H F audit checks project structure, schema, and audio cut risk. HyperFrames check then verifies runtime behavior, layout, motion, and text contrast.

title.zh-Hant: 人工 preview 仍是最後一關
title.en: Human preview remains the final gate

subtitle.zh-Hant: 節奏、發音、圖文可讀性，要在瀏覽器裡聽過看過，才按下 render。
subtitle.en: A person must still hear the pacing and pronunciation and see the typography.

narration.zh-Hant: 自動檢查不取代人工。節奏、發音和圖文可讀性，仍然要在瀏覽器 preview 裡聽過、看過，才按下 render。
narration.en: Automation does not replace a person. Someone still has to hear the pacing and pronunciation, inspect readability, and approve that specific language before render.

subtitle.zh-Hant: 一條可重跑的管線。Snowy HyperFrames 工作流 v2。
subtitle.en: One rerunnable pipeline. Snowy HyperFrames Workflow v2.

narration.zh-Hant: 從分鏡到影片，一條可重跑的管線。這就是 Snowy HyperFrames 工作流 v2。
narration.en: From storyboard to video through one rerunnable pipeline. This is Snowy HyperFrames Workflow version two.
